<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

<script>
fetch('https://acclamationstorage.blob.core.windows.net/taplist/taplist.json')
.then(response=>response.json())
.then(data=>{
const taplist=document.getElementById('taplist');
let products=data?.data?.productsList||[];
let messages=[];

products.sort((a,b)=>{
let aTap=/^\d{2}$/.test(a.shortName?.substring(0,2))?parseInt(a.shortName.substring(0,2)):999;
let bTap=/^\d{2}$/.test(b.shortName?.substring(0,2))?parseInt(b.shortName.substring(0,2)):999;
return aTap-bTap;
});

products.forEach(product=>{
if(product.available!==true)return;

let tapNumber='';
if(typeof product.shortName==='string'){
let tap=product.shortName.substring(0,2);
if(/^\d{2}$/.test(tap))tapNumber=parseInt(tap,10);
}

let text=((product.name||'')+' '+(product.description||'')).toUpperCase();

if(tapNumber===23 && text.includes('CHECK OUT OUR WINE & COCKTAIL MENU')){
return;
}

if(product.categoryId==113209){
messages.push(product);
return;
}

let type='';
if(product.categoryId==110402)type='beer';
else if(product.categoryId==110404)type='cider';
else if(product.categoryId==110405)type='na';
else return;

let item=document.createElement('li');
item.className='tap-item';

if(tapNumber!==''){
let tap=document.createElement('div');
tap.className='tap-number '+type;
tap.textContent=tapNumber;
item.appendChild(tap);
}

let content=document.createElement('div');
content.className='tap-content';

let name=document.createElement('div');
name.className='beer-name';
name.textContent=product.name||'';

let desc=document.createElement('div');
desc.className='beer-description';
desc.textContent=product.description||'';

content.appendChild(name);
content.appendChild(desc);
item.appendChild(content);

taplist.appendChild(item);
});

messages.forEach(message=>{
let item=document.createElement('li');
item.className='message-item';
item.textContent=message.description||message.name||'';
taplist.appendChild(item);
});

})
.catch(error=>console.error('Unable to load taplist:',error));
</script>
</body>
</html>
